description: Curated, frozen schema for the kiloclaw cloud agent. On connection, first call GET /v1/capabilities to receive a machine-readable description of every endpoint, request field, and response field. Use this document for the human-readable context.

language.note: All column descriptions are in English. Free-text fields in the source database are Hungarian. Diacritic-folded ASCII search is used, so Hungarian accented characters match their unaccented ASCII form (e.g. 'távoli' matches 'tavoli').

priority_fields.description: The three fields that matter most for helping on-the-ground workers. Search across them, and surface their values prominently in answers.

fields.name: devices[].raw
fields.description: Free-text device type(s) on this job. Often semicolon-separated, with model number, software version, hardware variant, and servo info inline.

fields.name: notes[body where kind='reported']
fields.description: The fault as reported by the customer. Free text in Hungarian.

fields.name: notes[body where kind='work']
fields.description: What the technician actually did to fix it. Free text in Hungarian.

JobCard.key: integer, primary key from the original sheet (KEY column). Stable across ETL.
JobCard.sorszam: string, legacy id like 'B00110601' or 'B240326002'. Year+month+sequence.
JobCard.reported_at: string, original 'YYYY.MM.DD' text from the sheet, may be null.
JobCard.reported_at_iso: string, normalized to 'YYYY-MM-DD', may be null.
JobCard.status: 'open' or 'closed' (original NY/Z column: 0 closed, 1 open — Phase 3 polarity fix, 2026-07-31).
JobCard.technician: string, semicolon-separated list of technician initials, may be null.
JobCard.problem_kategoria: string, primary issue category (e.g. 'Szoftver hiba', 'Hardver hiba', 'Mechanikai hiba'), may be null. Used for fast aggregation.
JobCard.problem_alkategoria: string, subcategory for more granular classification, may be null.
JobCard.sulyossag: string, severity level: 'alacsony' (low), 'kozepes' (medium), 'magas' (high), 'kritikus' (critical). May be null.
JobCard.customer: Customer object describing who reported the fault.
JobCard.devices: Array of Device objects, one per parsed device token.
JobCard.notes: Array of Note objects, in insertion order. Look at notes of kind 'reported' and 'work' to understand the job.

Device.raw: Original device string token, exactly as it appeared in the cell.
Device.model: Parsed leading model identifier, may be null.
Device.software: Parsed SW-... value, may be null.
Device.hardware: Parsed HW:... value, may be null.
Device.servos: Parsed Servok:... value, may be null.
Device.freeform: Anything left in the token that wasn't a model/sw/hw/servok, may be null.

Note.author: Author name or initials, may be null.
Note.created_at: ISO timestamp, may be null for legacy rows.

endpoints.GET /v1/health: Liveness + ETL info. No auth required.
endpoints.GET /v1/capabilities: Machine-readable list of every endpoint, request field, response field, auth requirement, and copy-pasteable example. Call this FIRST on connection.
endpoints.GET /v1/index: Distinct-value index (top customers, models, technicians, status counts, categories).
endpoints.POST /v1/jobs/search: Search. Body: { q?, customer?, device?, status?, date_from?, date_to?, kategoria?, sulyossag?, notes_contains?, limit?, offset?, fields? }. Returns up to `limit` JobCards ranked by relevance.
endpoints.GET /v1/jobs/:key: Full JobCard for a single job.
endpoints.GET /v1/jobs/:key/raw: The untouched original row from the source sheet by KEY. Useful for fields not in the specialized DB (dates, technician notes, image links, etc).
endpoints.POST /v1/jobs: Create a new job. Requires write token. Body: { customer: { name, zip?, address?, phone?, email? }, devices: string[], reported: string, work?: string, technician?: string }.
endpoints.POST /v1/jobs/:key/notes: Append a note. Body: { kind: 'reported'|'work'|'free', body, author? }. Requires write token.
endpoints.POST /v1/jobs/stats: Aggregate tickets. Body: { group_by: 'customer'|'device'|'technician'|'status'|'month'|'kategoria'|'sulyossag', filters... }. Returns [{ name, count }].
endpoints.GET /v1/categories: List all issue categories. No auth required.
endpoints.POST /v1/categories: Create a new issue category. Body: { nev, leiras? }. Requires write token.
endpoints.GET /v1/tags: List all tags. No auth required.
endpoints.POST /v1/tags: Create a new tag. Body: { nev }. Requires write token.
endpoints.GET /v1/tickets/:key/categories: Get categories linked to a ticket.
endpoints.POST /v1/tickets/:key/categories: Add a category to a ticket. Body: { kategoria_id }. Requires write token.
endpoints.DELETE /v1/tickets/:key/categories/:katI: Remove a category from a ticket. Requires write token.
endpoints.GET /v1/tickets/:key/tags: Get tags linked to a ticket.
endpoints.POST /v1/tickets/:key/tags: Add a tag to a ticket (auto-creates). Body: { nev }. Requires write token.
endpoints.DELETE /v1/tickets/:key/tags/:tagId: Remove a tag from a ticket. Requires write token.
endpoints.POST /v1/tickets/create: Create a complete ticket. Body: { customer_name, devices?, reported?, work?, technician?, problem_kategoria?, sulyossag?, ... }. Requires write token.
endpoints.POST /v1/tickets/modify: Modify any field by sorszam. Body: { sorszam, ...fields }. Requires write token.
endpoints.GET /v1/tickets/recent: Recent tickets. Query: hours (default 24), limit, status.
endpoints.GET /v1/tickets/recent-with-solution: Recent tickets that have work notes. Query: hours (default 168), limit.

constraints.no_update_or_delete: Existing jobs and notes cannot be modified or deleted. Only append.
constraints.no_raw_sql: There is no raw SQL endpoint.
constraints.result_caps: Search defaults to 20, max 100. The cache is precomputed for sub-millisecond reads.
